text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I did it, I did it, I really did it!! 
Traineeeeer!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOOOO~N!! Thank you sooooo 
muuuuuch~~!!

Achieving such great results in a GⅠ race 
is very reassuring as we aim for the Japan 
Derby.
choice_data_list:
Let's do our best in the Classic Class 
too!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yeeeaaahhh!!! Next year's definitely gonna 
be the absolute best year everrr!

And so, just as I was about to suggest 
next year's rotation schedule—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Could you stop making a racket in the 
underground walkway?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: "Taishiiin!! Hayahideee!!"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Good work, Ticket. That was a great race.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Even Taishin was holding her breath the 
moment you crossed the finish line.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: H-Huh!?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Wha—what passionate friendship!! Thank 
you, TAISHIIIIIN!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Aah, jeez! You're so loud and annoying!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
At any rate, I'm glad we achieved a good 
result. I'm looking forward to next year.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Next year is finally the Japanese 
Derby! I'm counting on both of you when 
the time comes!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Likewise. I won't let you have the 
win, though.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Even I...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
All riiiight! Let's give it everything 
we've got for the Japan Derbyyyy!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Though it'll probably hit before that.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Really!?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"You're aiming for it too, aren't you? 
—The Classic Triple Crown, that is."

The Classic Triple Crown. It is one of the 
highest honors, bestowed only upon the 
Umamusume who triumphs in all three: the 
Satsuki Sho, the Nippon Derby, and the 
Kikuka Sho...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
The Triple Crown...! O-Oh, right! I was 
only ever thinking about the Japan 
Derby...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Ehh...

This is my chance to propose the race 
rotation that I missed telling her about 
earlier.

"The ultimate goal is the Nippon Derby. 
However, if we're aiming for the Derby, 
naturally, the Satsuki Sho comes into view 
as well."

"If only to experience the atmosphere of a 
Classic race, I definitely want to aim for 
the 'Satsuki Sho'."

And so, our first target race for next 
year will be one of the Satsuki Sho trial 
races—
choice_data_list: Why not enter the Yayoi Sho?
Why not enter the Yayoi Sho?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: The Yayoi Sho...!

The moment Winning Ticket muttered those 
words, the air around Narita Taishin 
suddenly grew tense...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
So that's where you'll be facing them 
first.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Taishin, you're running in the Yayoi 
Sho!?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Just so you know, I won't hold back.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"Whether my opponent is you or anyone 
else. ...I will definitely overtake you."

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
W-Wooooooh~! I'm all fired up!!! 
Alriiiight! First up is the Yayoi Sho!

—At any rate, the days of charging full 
speed ahead toward the next goal had 
begun!
